summary: Runtime-neutral model gateway core shared by every gateway adapter (Workers/D1, Node/PostgreSQL, Node/SQLite). It owns decisions (route plan, holds, settlement, coded errors, usage, SSE metering); adapters own durability and HTTP through GatewayPorts.
context_hints: Boundary: no node:*, cloudflare:*, pg/drizzle/SQLite, Loro, @clash/shared-runtime or Workers Env. Enforced by the gateway-core override in .eslintrc.boundaries.json (pnpm lint:boundaries) and proven by scripts/architecture-boundaries.test.ts, including a transitive check that only zod is reached.
Import shared-types through loro-free subpaths (`@clash/shared-types/model-routing`); the package root re-exports Loro-backed modules.

Routing is a facade: planGatewayRoutes returns listModelUpstreamRoutes' order unchanged over the supplied catalog and one credential scope (official or tenant, never mixed), and adds a retry class per attempt. Do not reimplement ordering here.
Money is integer micro-credits (1 credit = 1_000_000) computed in bigint and rounded up once per line; no floats, no markup. Media/AIGC failures settle at zero; text settles delivered output.
Every reservation ends in exactly one budgets.settle, which writes the ledger row and closes holds in one adapter transaction, idempotent by request id.
Every failure is a GatewayError whose code maps to an HTTP status plus OpenAI and Anthropic error bodies (errors.ts). A port a deployment lacks rejects with GATEWAY_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE (501).
New adapters run describeGatewayContract from @clash/gateway-core/contract; unmet capabilities go in knownGaps and must keep failing until fixed.

subdirectories.src/contract: Shared Vitest contract suite over GatewayPorts plus the in-memory stub run.
subdirectories.src/testing: In-memory GatewayPorts stub and a catalog fixture built through shared-types.

key_files.src/ports.ts: GatewayPorts: clock, ids, identity, routes, credentials, budgets, limits, ledger, blobs, retention, scheduler, audit, logger, upstream; unavailablePort.
key_files.src/retention.ts: Body retention (#353): retainGatewayExchange (bodies to blobs, metadata to retention; never throws, coded failure + compensating delete), readRetainedExchange (NOT_RETAINED / EXPIRED / RETENTION_FAILED), purgeExpiredGatewayBodies (idempotent), the x-gateway-retention header; createRetainedBodyCopy for streams (capped side copy, GATEWAY_RETENTION_TRUNCATED marker + truncated metadata).
key_files.src/errors.ts: Closed GATEWAY_* error table -> HTTP status, OpenAI and Anthropic error bodies, Retry-After.
key_files.src/routing.ts: planGatewayRoutes over listModelUpstreamRoutes; nextGatewayAttempt failover/exhaustion decisions.
key_files.src/request.ts: OpenAI chat, Anthropic messages and media request normalization; upstream body preparation (include_usage).
key_files.src/usage.ts: Usage accumulator for OpenAI and Anthropic payloads/stream events (input, output, cache read, cache write).
key_files.src/budget.ts: Hold computation and pure reserve/settle arithmetic, hard/soft/alert enforcement and the flags a reservation raises (budgetFlags), outcome charging rules, invariant checks.
key_files.src/limits.ts: GatewayRateLimitSchema (rpm/tpm/concurrency/mediaJobs, the one rate-limit schema), tightest-limit merge, rate/concurrency decision shape and fixed-window helpers.
key_files.src/sse.ts: WHATWG SSE parser/encoder, a pass-through usage capture TransformStream (usage, end marker, final-output flag, content bytes) and an event transform that drops whole events (the injected include_usage chunk) and sets each event's model to the public code, changing only that JSON value's bytes (sseModelRewrite).
key_files.src/stream.ts: #348 relayGatewayStream: tee() the upstream body, one branch to the caller unbuffered, one through the usage tap; ends once (completed/truncated/upstream_error/timeout/client_aborted), aborting the upstream on disconnect; encodeGatewayStreamState for coded in-stream failures.
key_files.src/holds.ts: #348 sweepExpiredGatewayHolds: idempotent stale-hold sweeper over budgets.expiredHolds/expire; never settle_failed holds.
key_files.src/admission.ts: admitGatewayRequest / settleGatewayRequest composed over the ports; settleMediaGeneration (accepted media job: success charged its units, failure zero).
key_files.src/app.ts: createGatewayApp(ports, { basePath, waitUntil }): framework-free fetch handler. OpenAI chat completions, plain and streamed (hold before the first byte, failover only before it, observed-usage settlement, coded in-stream settlement/retention failures), exactly-once settlement, no upstream error bodies forwarded.
key_files.src/catalog-policy.ts: applyGatewayCatalogPolicy: DeepSeek Flash only (applied in admission for every adapter); isBlockedDeepSeekModel applies the same rule to price-book rows.
key_files.src/billing.ts: Credit billing decisions (#352): anchored calendar billing periods, wallet balance, expiringGrant (period grant consumed first, never below open holds), assertPriceDraftPolicy (units, integer amounts, unique rates, DeepSeek Flash only).
key_files.src/contract/index.ts: describeGatewayContract(name, setup) with capabilities and knownGaps; its data-plane cases drive createGatewayApp with a suite-owned fetch-stub upstream.
